officialSendingAgency.name: Agency of Overseas Employment
officialSendingAgency.ministry: Ministry of Labour, Migration and Employment of Population of the Republic of Tajikistan

evidenceNotes: The Tajikistan Ministry of Labour official notice explicitly states EPS-TOPIK employment in the manufacturing sector and registration from 2026-03-02 through 2026-03-05.
HRD Korea's 2nd Tajikistan Point System page has the same registration period and records test announcement 2026-03-20 and test period 2026-03-28 through 2026-03-29, General CBT, Point System.
The official local notice states a 330 somoni exam fee, age 18–39 for the cycle, foreign-passport data, and a 3.5×4.5 cm white-background electronic color photo.

HRD Korea's official skills-candidate row published 2026-04-06 and final Point System result row published 2026-05-08 both use examNot=10, matching the direct 2nd Tajikistan Manufacturing schedule. Post-selection medical/job-file, visa/training/departure exact rules remain HOLD.

Tajikistan's Ministry of Labour states in official EPS program guidance that registration and dispatch services provided by the Agency of Overseas Employment are fully free and operate without intermediaries. This 2025 framework evidence is used only for the zero-broker process principle, not for 2026 cycle dates, fees or post-selection requirements.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.authority: Agency of Overseas Employment / Ministry of Labour
stages.action: Current Tajikistan Manufacturing notice requires Tajik citizenship, Korean-language ability under EPS-TOPIK, age 18–39 for this cycle (DOB 1986-03-03 through 2008-03-02), no criminal record, no Korea entry ban/deportation issue, and health without infectious disease; use the original official notice for exact applicant assessment.

stages.title: 2nd Point System Manufacturing registration
stages.authority: Agency of Overseas Employment / HRD Korea
stages.action: Manufacturing applications were accepted 2026-03-02 through 2026-03-05. This local Manufacturing notice matches the HRD Korea 2nd Point System registration window.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK examination fee
stages.action: The official Tajikistan Manufacturing notice states an examination fee of 330 somoni.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Use the foreign passport and exact identity information required by the current official notice. Information must match the passport and be entered correctly in Latin letters.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: The official notice requires a phone number, an electronic copy of the foreign passport, and an electronic color photo 3.5×4.5 cm on a white background. Incorrect passport data can invalidate exam participation or later visa processing.

stages.title: Test announcement
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Agency of Overseas Employment
stages.action: HRD Korea records the test announcement date as 2026-03-20 for Tajikistan's 2nd Point System.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — 2nd Point System Manufacturing
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Agency of Overseas Employment
stages.action: HRD Korea records the General CBT Point System test period as 2026-03-28 through 2026-03-29. Manufacturing sector linkage is supported by the matching official Tajikistan local notice.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Agency of Overseas Employment
stages.action: HRD Korea's official skills-candidate row published 2026-04-06 uses examNot=10, exactly matching the 2nd Tajikistan Manufacturing schedule.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Agency of Overseas Employment
stages.action: HRD Korea's official Point System final-result row published 2026-05-08 uses examNot=10, exactly matching the 2nd Tajikistan Manufacturing schedule. Final test selection does not guarantee employer selection.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Tajikistan psychology stage is asserted from the verified 2026 Manufacturing sources.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.authority: Agency of Overseas Employment / authorized provider
stages.action: The registration notice requires applicants to be healthy and free from infectious disease, but exact post-selection provider/checklist/fee rules remain current-notice specific.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.authority: Agency of Overseas Employment / HRD Korea
stages.action: After verified final selection, follow current Tajikistan candidate-file instructions. Exact 2026 post-selection documents and timing remain HOLD.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.authority: Agency of Overseas Employment / HRD Korea
stages.action: Official Tajikistan EPS framework guidance says registration/dispatch services of the Agency of Overseas Employment are fully free and without intermediaries. Only officially qualified candidates proceed into EPS employer selection; no intermediary can guarantee priority or placement.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Korean employers select through the official EPS system. Tajikistan's official EPS guidance states Agency registration/dispatch services operate without intermediaries; no broker can guarantee a specific employer.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.authority: HRD Korea / Agency of Overseas Employment
stages.action: If selected, follow current official Tajikistan/EPS instructions for SLC review/signing.

stages.title: Post-SLC Tajikistan requirements
stages.action: Follow current official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa, payments and departure.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.authority: Agency of Overseas Employment / Korean mission
stages.action: Use the current Tajikistan/Korean-mission visa checklist and fees. Exact 2026 downstream details remain HOLD.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only official training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage; follow current Tajikistan instructions if a final medical recheck is required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.authority: Agency of Overseas Employment / HRD Korea
stages.action: Travel only after contract, visa, training and official departure requirements are complete.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete official Korea-side employment education and handover.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for wage or labor issues.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process.

officialZeroBrokerEvidence.authority: Ministry of Labour, Migration and Employment of Population of the Republic of Tajikistan
officialZeroBrokerEvidence.rule: Agency services for EPS registration and dispatch are stated as fully free and without intermediaries.
officialZeroBrokerEvidence.scopeBoundary: Use only as a stable EPS channel/anti-broker principle. Do not infer that the 2026 exam fee, medical costs, visa fees, travel costs or other current-cycle charges are zero.
